text: Confirmed and filed #6593: APPEND FROM TYPE CSV imports a reordered CSV header as data. VFP9 docs state first-line CSV field names are ignored; installed VFP COM with target NAME,NOTE and file NOTE,NAME / HELLO,ALICE imports one row positionally (NAME=HELLO, NOTE=ALICE). Copperfin imports two rows, treating NOTE,NAME as data. Separate BOM-free trigger from #6591. Issue verified OPEN and owner-authored, labels bug/runtime/agent-approved. No production changes.
